archive_description: Store finished campaigns and decks in the database. These could then be compiled into profiles.
archive_new_description: Choose the campaign you want to archive.
archive_chaos_reinit_confirm: Replace the chaos bag with this difficulty's starting tokens?
archive_history_help: Snapshots taken automatically when you leave the editor (the 20 most recent across all campaigns). Restoring replaces this campaign with the chosen snapshot.
archive_history_empty: No autosaves yet — leave and reopen the editor to create one.
archive_history_restore_confirm: Replace this campaign with the selected autosave? Your current version will be overwritten.
archive_change_campaign_confirm: Changing the campaign will clear all campaign logs. Continue?
archive_draft_help: While in draft mode, this campaign will not contribute to your profile statistics.
archive_players_help: Add other players who participated in this campaign. They will be able to view this Archived Campaign.
archive_players_friends_notice: Friends feature is not yet available.
archive_players_sub_empty: No sub-players defined under your account yet.
archive_unsaved_prompt: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
archive_delete_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
archive_no_campaigns: You have no archived campaigns yet.
archive_players_play_groups_empty: You have no play groups yet.
archive_import_export_description: Back up or restore your campaign data. Export everything to a JSON file, or import a previously exported file.
archive_created: New Archived Campaign created — you're now editing it.
archive_export_description: Download all your campaign data as a JSON file. This includes every campaign you own, along with all decks, campaign logs, and player assignments.
archive_import_description: Upload a JSON file that was previously exported from arkham.life. Campaigns you already own will be skipped. If the exported campaign was created on a different account, a new copy is created instead.
archive_import_result_new_id: Campaigns from another account (imported with new ID)
archive_import_result_players_skipped: Player entries skipped (UID not found or not accessible)
archive_import_error: Import failed. Make sure you selected a valid arkham.life export file.
archive_import_invalid_format: Invalid file format. Expected an arkham.life export JSON.
archive_unsaved_tab_change_body: You have unsaved changes in this tab. Would you like to save them before switching, or discard?
archive_players_auto_save_help: Changes in this tab are saved automatically. Adding or removing players, assigning deck owners, and updating permissions take effect immediately.
archive_logs_no_campaign: Select a campaign to manage logs.
archive_logs_no_data: No log data available for this campaign.
archive_ach_tip_extra: Checked for you from your recorded campaign data (more than the log alone). Tap to see what it checks.
archive_ach_tip_log: Checked for you from your recorded campaign logs. Tap to see what it checks.
archive_ach_tip_manual: You check this off as 'Earned' yourself.
archive_ach_extra_hint: Could be automatically checked from combination of data of other tabs than the log alone.
archive_ach_prereq_warn: Expected prerequisite not found in your recorded logs.
archive_ach_modal_extra: Checked for you from your recorded campaign data (more than the log alone). It looks for:
archive_ach_modal_log: Checked for you from purely your recorded campaign logs. It looks for:
archive_logs_validation_blocked: Resolve the conflicting log entries before saving.
